visual.name: revisionLogEditor
visual.description: Editable grid over FactScheduleChange revision events, backed by Cloudflare D1. Override the revision reason, add a note, or exclude an event.

dataRoles.name: columns
dataRoles.description: Drag any model fields here (the visible revision-log columns). Reorder by drag in the visual. Use the Table > Editable columns position setting to slot the editable Revision Reason / Note / Exclude columns at any position.

dataRoles.name: revisionKey
dataRoles.description: Hidden join key that identifies each revision event (OrderLineID | ChangeDate | ChangeTime). Used to look up and write override fields. Treated as an opaque string.

dataRoles.name: hiddenColumns
dataRoles.description: Fields here are not displayed in the visual but are included in Power BI's standard 'Export data' output. Use for D1 override fields (Revision Reason / Note / Exclude).

dataRoles.name: currentUser
dataRoles.description: Bind a measure like CurrentUserEmail = USERPRINCIPALNAME() here. Used to look up the viewer's role for permission-gated edits.
